name: Agent Tool (HTTP)
description: Declares an HTTP tool an Agent Task's LLM can call. This task is never run by the engine — it's read as config by the agent-task-worker. Place inside an Agent Task (ad hoc sub-process), alongside the Agent LLM Call task.

properties.label: Tool Name
properties.description: The function name the LLM will use to call this tool. No spaces, e.g. lookup_account.

pattern.message: Must be a valid function name: letters, numbers, underscores, not starting with a number.

properties.label: Tool Description
properties.description: Tells the LLM what this tool does and when to use it. This is what the model reads to decide whether to call it — be specific.

properties.label: Input Schema (JSON Schema)
properties.description: JSON Schema describing the arguments the LLM must supply when calling this tool, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}},"required":["query"]}

properties.label: URL
properties.description: The tool's HTTP endpoint. Use {{argName}} to interpolate an argument the LLM supplied for this call, e.g. https://api.example.com/accounts/{{accountId}}

properties.label: Headers (JSON)
properties.description: Optional JSON object of request headers. Supports {{argName}} interpolation.

properties.label: Body Template
properties.description: Optional request body, sent for POST/PATCH/PUT. Use {{argName}} to interpolate an argument the LLM supplied for this call.
